comparison.objective: Press a spring cord lock while threading a shock cord; candidate screens finishing media from retained washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained button force plus deformable-cord insertion versus bulk pouring and controlled agitation of a bimanually held perforated tool.
comparison.success_condition: Cord passes through with ≥40 mm on each side and spring-grips after release; candidate requires ≥98% receiver recovery with all washers retained and no spill.
comparison.reason: Both involve passage through an opening, but the tested mechanics—force-gated cord threading versus orientation-dependent granular separation—are meaningfully different.
